Stage 3 · Grammar

Grammar

on Monday · in July · the 3rd of May
PrepositionUseExample
on+ dayon Monday
in+ month / yearin July · in 2025
the … ofdatesthe third of May
What'sasking the dateWhat's the date?
  • on + day: on Monday, on Saturday, on my birthday.
  • in + month / year: in July, in December, in 2025.
  • Dates: the + ordinal + of + month → the third of May (3 May).
  • Ask: What's the date? — It's the first of June. When's your birthday? — In May.

→ Present Simple (I work, she works) comes next.

🔧 Build it yourself
  • 🔧 Build it yourself
  • Build it: ON + day and date (on Monday, on the 3rd of May), IN + month (in July).
  • ⚠ В понедельник → ON Monday. В июле → IN July. Days take on, months take in.

Stage 6 · Speaking

Your turn

Write two short lines with a day and a date: on … / in … / the … of … .

When you finish, open the model answer and check yourself.

Model answer

My birthday is on the fifth of July. My holiday is in August. See you on Monday!

Check yourself:

  • Did you use on + a day (on Monday)?
  • Did you use in + a month (in July)?
  • Did you write a date (the third of May)?

Why

Use on + day: on Monday. Use in + month: in June.
